title: OAuth bearer tokens require this server's audience, explicit role mapping, and session isolation

criteria.given: an OAuth issuer is configured without an audience
criteria.then: bearer authentication stays disabled, every bearer token is rejected, and the configuration warning explains why

criteria.given: a signed bearer token names a different audience
criteria.then: the decoder rejects it with an invalid-token response

criteria.given: a token contains an unmapped role claim, including ADMIN or ROLE_ADMIN
criteria.then: it grants no authority; only an explicit operator mapping can grant a Saiku role, as documented

criteria.given: a bearer request also carries an existing session cookie
criteria.then: the filter restores the session's original security context after the request
